mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in building a kitchen addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planning a kitchen addition involves initial design, structural engineering, permitting, foundation pouring, exterior framing, utility rough-ins, drywall, and interior finishes. At Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms, the project begins by assessing your property goals and drafting plans that match your home's existing roofline and exterior style. Once permits are approved, the crew builds the new foundation, frames walls, routes plumbing and electrical lines, hangs and finishes drywall, and installs custom cabinetry, countertops, and appliances before completing final inspections.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes architectural planning, permitting, pouring the foundation, framing, running plumbing and electrical lines, drywalling, and installing cabinets and finishes.
